queries.prompt: we render an object id into a buffer to know what the mouse is over, but reading that pixel back every frame tanks our framerate

queries.prompt: two surfaces at the same pixel sometimes report the wrong object because both threads pass the depth test and the last one wins. The stored id doesn't match the stored depth
